name: collections: single-end gzipped FASTA becomes a flat list, not a pair
description: Assembled contigs arrive one file per sample, so the structure is list rather than list:paired. The auto rule pairs only on evidence, and names carrying no mate marker must not be married into pairs; this is the branch a user with assemblies hits first, and it is the one that would silently produce a wrong collection shape rather than an error.
inputs: My current history has three gzipped FASTA files, one per sample. Group them into a collection called "assemblies" and tag it "contigs". Go ahead and do it.
